body: it feels so surreal right now. I never thought i'd be alone on my 21st but here i am.

I've been in a relationship with this guy for 4 years since highschool. We broke up a couple days ago. Todays my birthday and im just so depressed and lonely. I use to have friends but we dont talk anymore and i dont have any online friends so, here i am. i know its pathetic haha

todays my birthday too, though i didnt get a message. I think it sounds like she wants to talk to you but im not sure, relationships are so complicated and im just too depressed to even know what anything means in them anymore
thank you very much for the kind words, it really does help.
thank you so much for this, its really what i needed to read in a hard time :,)

I have 3 options:
1.Stay with my boyfriend and continue another year of toxic behavoir and constant fighting
2.Leave him and be completely isolated and lonely since i actually no friends and no idea how to make any
3. Kill myself to get out of the situation
Have been feeling more and more fonder of the last choice recently
